channel.title: Dell Kaufeld on More Than Games
channel.description: Recent content in Dell Kaufeld on More Than Games

item.title: Review: Starfinder Second Edition GM Core (Paizo)
item.description: Fans and players launched into the new world of Starfinder Second Edition (2e) when the Player Core released in early August. 16+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Second Edition Player Core (Paizo)
item.description: On Thursday morning of Gen Con in 2017, Paizo released the Starfinder Roleplaying Game. 16+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Tea Garden (Capstone Games)
item.description: It’s another busy day in your tea garden. 12+, 2-4 players, 90 minutes

item.title: Review: Elemystic (Wise Wizard Games)
item.description: When I first saw Elemystic from Wise Wizard Games, it was so small I thought it was an expansion, not an entire game. 12+, 2 players, 20-30 minutes

item.title: Review: Tacta (The OP)
item.description: Phrases like ‘tactical strategy game” and “easy to teach” don’t usually go together, but thanks to its clever graphic design, that actually works in Tacta. 10+, 2-6 players, 20-30 minutes

item.title: Review: Vegas Showdown (Renegade Games)
item.description: The glitz and glamour of the Las Vegas Strip is legendary. 12+, 3-5 players, 75 minutes

item.title: Review: Tangram City (Capstone Games)
item.description: The name on the box declares the game’s basic idea right from the start, but Uwe Rosenberg’s Tangram City from Capstone Games still keeps plenty of surprises under wraps. 8+, 1-5 players, 30 minutes

item.title: Review: Milkman (Dice Hate Me Games)
item.description: Milkman, from Dice Hate Me Games, takes you to a time when people were more directly connected to the origins of their food, much like today’s “farm to fork” movement. 10+, 2-4 players, 40-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Butterfly Garden (Capstone Games)
item.description: Watching spring flowers begin to bloom outside feels deliciously appropriate since this month’s game focuses on flowers, gardens, blooms, and butterflies. 8+, 2-4 players, 30 minutes

item.title: Review: Tower Up (Monolith)
item.description: In Tower Up from Monolith, two to four players take the roles of construction companies expanding the city’s downtown. 10+, 2-4 players, 40-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Colt Express Big Box (Ludonaute)
item.description: Running between train cars, grabbing bags of gold, climbing onto the roof, and getting whacked by an overhanging swivel arm — it’s all in a day’s work for train robbing varmints in just about every movie about the Old West. 10+, 3-8 players, 40-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Acquire 60th Anniversary (Renegade)
item.description: Sixty years is a big anniversary, whether it’s for a company or your favorite couple. 14+, 1-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Kinfire Chronicles: Night’s Fall (Incredible Dream)
item.description: Kinfire Chronicles: Night’s Fall by Incredible Dream Studios is the newest — and possibly largest, because this game is physically huge — installment in a series of titles set in the fantasy world of Atios. 14+, 1-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Star Trek: Star Realms (UVS Games, Wise Wizard)
item.description: When I first saw Star Trek: Star Realms from UVS Games and Wise Wizard Games, my mental sound effects library immediately pulled up the swoosh-squeak of the original Enterprise’s doors — and, of course,“Engage!” and “Fire!” heard in several actors’ voices. 14+, 2-4 players, 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Starfinder 2nd Edition Playtest Rulebook (Paizo)
item.description: Seven years after its successful launch, the Starfinder Roleplaying Game is headed for a second edition — and Paizo wants everyone to get a voice in its creation. 13+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Distilled (Paverson Games)
item.description: You still can’t quite believe it, but the letter in your hands is very clear. 14+, 1-5 players, 30 minutes/player

item.title: Review: Adventure Party (Smirk and dagger)
item.description: Every fantasy adventure features the stuff of bardic songs: terrible monsters, dangerous locales, dastardly villains, and heroic deeds — and, of course, a tavern where our heroes gather and enjoy each other’s company. 14+, 3-8 players, 20-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Sandbag (Bezier Games)
item.description: A lot of people picked up interesting hobbies over the last few years. 15+, 3-6 players, 30 minutes

item.title: Review: First Rat (Pegasus Spiele)
item.description: Everybody knows the moon is made of cheese — and for the comic book-reading rats of the local junkyard, it’s an article of faith. 10+, 1-5 players, 30-75 minutes

item.title: Review: Kobolds Ate My Baby! The Orange Book (9th Level Games)
item.description: During my first visit to the Origins Game Fair many years ago, someone standing nearby suddenly yelled, “All hail King Torg!” at the top of their lungs. 8+, 2-8 players, 2 hours

item.title: Review: Salton Sea (Devir Games)
item.description: In a time when global warming, alternative energy, and electric vehicles seem to be on everyone’s mind, the Salton Sea in California feels like a mirage. 14+, 1-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: The Rich and the Good (Ares Games)
item.description: In The Rich and the Good from Ares Games, you’re a commodities trader in the midst of the Second Industrial Revolution. 13+, 2-5 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Express Route (The OP)
item.description: It’s 1959 in the alternate reality of Express Route from The OP, and catalog shopping is exploding throughout the US! 10+, 1-4 players, 60-90 minutes

item.title: Review: Dodos Riding Dinos (Detestable Games)
item.description: Life was calm and peaceful on Dodino Island — right up to the point when a meteor fell on the ruling dino and dodo, leaving the island without leadership. 14+, 1-6 players, 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Romi Rami (Hachette)
item.description: Confession time: I’m not a big fan of rummy games. 8+, 2-4 players, 30 minutes

item.title: Review: Sushi Boat (Japanime Games)
item.description: I hope you’re hungry, because we’re bringing a sushi restaurant to your table. 8+, 2-5 players, 30-75 minutes

item.title: Review: Bonsai (DV Games)
item.description: There’s something magical about bonsai trees. 8+, 1-4 players, 40 minutes

item.title: Review: Quarto (Gigamic, Hachette)
item.description: There are luck games and pure strategy games. 8+, 2 players, 15 minutes

item.title: Review: Clash of Cultures: Monumental Edition (WizKids)
item.description: You stand in the knee-deep grass of a rolling prairie. 14+, 2-4 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: Galileo Project (Sorry We Are French)
item.description: There’s a certain joy that comes from playing an elegantly designed game. 14+, 2-4 players, 40-80 minutes

item.title: Review: Shapers of Gaia (WizKids)
item.description: After a millennia of waiting, Gaia is ready to be reborn — and you and your fellow Shapers are ready to make it happen. 14+, 2-3 players, 60-90 minutes

item.title: Review: Puerto Rico 1897 (Ravensburger)
item.description: Andreas Seyfarth’s Puerto Rico has been reprinted and expanded over the years and even given the deluxe anniversary treatment. 12+, 2-5 players, 90 to 150 minutes

item.title: Review: Broken and Beautiful (Left Justified Studio)
item.description: Broken and Beautiful, from Left Justified Studio, is a deceptively wicked little game. 12+, 2-4 players, 15 minutes

item.title: Review: Starfinder Interstellar Species (Paizo)
item.description: When Paizo’s Starfinder roleplaying game launched, players could choose among only a handful of species options for their characters. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Galaxy Trucker Keep on Trucking Expansion (Czech Game Edition)
item.description: Anyone who ever read the rules of Galaxy Trucker from Czech Games Edition knows that truckers can add a lot of different pieces to their craft, and they should add as many of all of them as possible. 8+, 2-4 players, 30 minutes

item.title: Review: Boop (Smirk and Laughter)
item.description: Cats get into everything. 10+, 2 players, about 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Lost Ruins of Arnak (Czech Games Edition)
item.description: The moment you set up this game on your table, you’ll feel teleported into your favorite archaeological adventure movie — most likely that series featuring the guy who runs away from giant boulders and can’t lose his hat no matter how hard he tries. 12+, 1-4 players, about 30 mins. per player

item.title: Review: Starfinder Drift Crisis (Paizo)
item.description: It just happened. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Free Radicals (WizKids/NECA)
item.description: When we gaze across the variety of game systems, our eyes always linger on asymmetrical games. 14+, 2-5 players, 90 minutes

item.title: Review: The Loop (Pandasaurus Games)
item.description: Oh no! 12+, 1-4 players, 60 minutes

item.title: Review: The Goonies: Never Say Die (Funko Games)
item.description: We’ve seen lots of companies take the characters from a movie or TV show, slap them haphazardly onto a game framework, and count on fans to buy their creation just because of the name. 12+, 2-5 players, 50 minutes

item.title: Review: Pathfinder 2e Complete Wizard Chronicle (Beadle and Grimm)
item.description: Everyone who loves roleplaying games handles their character sheets and game notes in different ways. 14+, 2-5 players, 90 minutes

item.title: Review: Starfinder Galactic Magic (Paizo)
item.description: There’s a rhythm to the expansion books for roleplaying games. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Wild Space (Pandasaurus)
item.description: This review is a little late. 10+, 1-5 players, 3 to set up; 25-30 to play

item.title: Review: Cindr (Smirk and Dagger)
item.description: *“Looking for a dragon to light up your life? 14+, 1-5 players, 3 to set up; 25-30 to play

item.title: Review: Alice in Wonderland Fluxx (Looney Labs)
item.description: If any piece of literature deserves to be enshrined in a Fluxx deck, Lewis Carroll’s Alice in Wonderland stories certainly qualify. 8+, 2-6 players, 2 to set up; 5-30 to play

item.title: Review: Galaxy Trucker 2nd edition (Czech Game Edition)
item.description: When a company comes out with a new, updated version for one of their classic games, you can pretty much count on two things: the new one will cost more — sometimes a lot more — and it’ll add a bunch of complicated new features so it’s harder to learn and takes longer to play. 8+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up; 20-60 to play

item.title: Review: Starfinder Galaxy Exploration Manual (Paizo)
item.description: The world is a big place to explore, but it’s not much compared to a whole universe. 13+, 4-7 players, 1-4 hours to set up, 4-6 hours to play

item.title: Review: Doodle Dungeon (Pegasus Spiele)
item.description: When your new dungeon turns out to be nothing but an empty cave, it’s time to channel your inner dungeon builder and get to work. 10+, 2-4 players, 4 to set up, 45-60 to play

item.title: Review: Duel of Wands: Kids on Brooms Card Game
item.description: Every student at the school of magic knows the dueling rules. 10+, 2 players, 3 to set up, 30-45 to play

item.title: Review: Cubitos (AEG)
item.description: Dice love to race. 14+, 2-4 players, 10 to set up, 30-60 to play

item.title: Review: Gods Love Dinosaurs (Pandasaurus Games)
item.description: It’s good to be a deity. 8+, 2-5 players, 5 to set up, 45-60 to play

item.title: Review: Tiny Epic Dinosaurs (Gamelyn Games)
item.description: Don’t let the cute box art with playful dinosaurs and a sunny sky fool you. 14+, 1-4 players, 5 to set up, 30-60 to play

item.title: Review: Pan Am (Funko Games)
item.description: I grew up listening to my dad’s stores stories about working for Pan Am as a mechanic and then a pilot, so when a board game with the Pan Am globe appeared on the scene, I knew we had to give it a try. 12+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 60 to play

item.title: Review: Pathfinder Beginner Box (Paizo)
item.description: Starting any hobby can feel daunting. 13+, 2-5 players, 60 minutes

item.title: Review: Homeworlds and Nomids (Looney Labs)
item.description: Many game people — our family included — have a long-standing love for the Looney Labs pyramids games. 10+, 2 (Homeworlds), 2-10 (Nomids) players, 30-60 minutes (Homeworlds), 2-10 minutes (Nomids)

item.title: Review: Succulent (Renegade)
item.description: Gardening is calm and patient work that demands skill, planning, and an eye for color and design. 10+, 2-4 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Santa Monica (AEG)
item.description: Sun, sand, shopping, and relaxing. 14+, 2-4 players, 5 minutes

item.title: Review: Pathfinder 2e Arcane Spell Cards, Chase Cards, and Bestiary Battle Cards (Paizo)
item.description: When we think about new roleplaying game products, we usually imagine source books with rules, monsters, and character classes, adventure modules that explore some new part of the world, or maps to simplify combat and exploration. 8+, 3-6 players

item.title: Review: Deck of Many Worlds and Space Station Flip-Tiles (Paizo)
item.description: In the futuristic universe of Starfinder, players can experience an endless number of fantastical and unique planets, all teeming with curious, exotic, and often dangerous species and locations. 8+, 3-6 players

item.title: Review: Cabo Deluxe (Bezier Games)
item.description: Unicorns capture the imagination. 8+, 2-4 players, 3 to set up, 30-45 to play

item.title: Review: Hues and Cues (The OP)
item.description: What color is “grape”? 8+, 3-10 players, 3 to set up, 30-45 to play

item.title: Review: Starfinder Character Operations Manual (Paizo)
item.description: Even with all of the playable races, fantastic feats, and customizable classes in Paizo’s Starfinder roleplaying game, sometimes your character idea still doesn’t exactly fit. 8+, 4-8 players, 30-60 to set up, 2-6 hours to play

item.title: Review: Imperial Settlers: Empires of the North (Portal Games)
item.description: Welcome to the frozen north, where the land is cold, the penguins are friendly, the drink is plentiful, and the islands are up for grabs. 8+, 1-4 players, 8 to set up, 45-90 to play

item.title: Review: SpyMaster (Calliope)
item.description: A furtive glance and an almost imperceptible nod. 8+, 2-6 players, 5 to set up, 20-50 to play

item.title: Review: Nemo Rising: Robur the Conqueror (Wizkids)
item.description: Set in the world of C. 8+, 1-4 players, 10 to set up, 90 to play

item.title: Review: Clip Cut Parks (Renegade)
item.description: The city needs more parks, and it’s up to you to build them. 8+, 1-4 players, 3 to set up, 30 minutes to play

item.title: Review: The Aquicorn Cove Board Game (Renegade)
item.description: Cooperative play, the challenge of balancing conservation with development, plus possibly the cutest meeples ever seen on a game board—all of that adds up to The Aquicorn Cove Board Game experience from Renegade Game Studios. 10+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 45-60 minutes to play

item.title: Review: Funkoverse Strategy Game Series (Funko Pop)
item.description: Almost anybody in pop culture fandom immediately recognizes a Funko Pop! 10+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 20-60 minutes to play

item.title: Review: Cat Lady Premium Edition (AEG)
item.description: You don’t need to dig (well, scratch) very deeply to find cat ladies everywhere you look. 8+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 30 minutes to play

item.title: Review: Volcanic Isle (Arcane Wonders)
item.description: Let’s start with the basics: In Volcanic Isle from Arcane Wonders, the island you’re on will sink. 13+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 45-60 minutes to play

item.title: Review: Smash Up: Oops, You Did It Again (AEG)
item.description: Illustration ideas: Shield Maiden, High Noon, Honorable Combat, Priest of Anubis 14+, 2+ players, 4 to set up, 45 to play

item.title: Review: Topiary (Renegade)
item.description: Gazing across a garden of sculpted plants known as topiary brings joy to most any heart. 10+, 2-4 players, 4 to set up, 10-20 to play

item.title: Review: Sentient (Renegade)
item.description: If the artwork in Sentient from Renegade Games is accurate, we look forward to a future filled with shiny intelligent robots and fascinating strategic decisions. 12+, 2-4 players, 4 to set up, 30-60 to play

item.title: Review: Doctor Who Fluxx Review
item.description: Let’s get this out of the way up front: One of us watched more Doctor Who than the other one. 8+, 2-6 players, 1 to set up, 5-40 to play

item.title: Review: Quadropolis: Public Services (Days of Wonder)
item.description: Congratulations, Mayor! 8+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 30-60 to play
